description:
Maven/JPMS wrapper activating Heisenberg (MicroProfile Fault Tolerance 4.1) in a
        vidocq deployment. No own Java class — the integration relies entirely on
        heisenberg-cdi-vauban's BuildCompatibleExtension (discovery of @Retry/@Timeout/
        @CircuitBreaker/@Bulkhead/@Fallback/@Asynchronous and registration of the fault-tolerance
        interceptors). Mirrors vidocq-runtime-dirac-metrics-extension / knock-health-extension.
